newsitem.title: USA: Chiplease tenders for Sobieski Bancorp.
newsitem.headline: Chiplease tenders for Sobieski Bancorp.

text.p: Chiplease Inc, an investment and leasing company based in Chicago, said Monday it is making a tender offer of $18.20 per share for Sobieski Bancorp Inc.

In a Dec 3 letter to Sobieski released in a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, lawyers for Chiplease said the offer is for all of the outstanding Sobieski shares, with a minimum of at least 50 percent, subject to regulatory approval.
Chiplease also said it wants to call a special meeting of shareholders to change Sobieski's charter, including re-chartering Sobieski as a national bank.
Chiplease said it took the move because of Sobieski's failure to support its plan to acquire up to 25 percent of Sobieski's stock and its refusal to give it a board seat.
Chiplease said it was disappointed by Sobieski's plan to go into commercial real estate lending, which it said was unwise.
Chiplease holds a 10.99 percent stake in Sobieski, or 96,600 common shares.
